# Continue exploring - click red more times to see the full cycle
ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_blocks(row_str):
    row_str = row_str[10:56]
    blocks = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(row_str):
        if row_str[i] != 'c':
            color = row_str[i]
            while i < len(row_str) and row_str[i] == color:
                i += 1
            blocks.append(color)
        else:
            i += 1
    return blocks

# Collect all states
states = []
# First, record current state
current = {r: get_blocks(ascii[r]) for r in [19, 25, 31, 37, 43]}
states.append(current)

# Click red until we see a repeat
seen = {str(current): 0}
step = 0
while step < 15:  # safety limit
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 32, 'col': 4}])
    ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    current = {r: get_blocks(ascii[r]) for r in [19, 25, 31, 37, 43]}
    state_key = str(current)
    if state_key in seen:
        print(f"Cycle detected! State {step+1} matches state {seen[state_key]}")
        break
    seen[state_key] = step + 1
    states.append(current)
    step += 1

print(f"\n=== All {len(states)} unique states ===")
for i, state in enumerate(states):
    print(f"State {i}:")
    for r in [19, 25, 31, 37, 43]:
        print(f"  Row {r}: {state[r]}")
